title: Yahoo sold tech news site Engadget to Static Media in a deal that was signed in early February and is scheduled to close later in March (David Pierce/The Verge)
summary: David Pierce / The Verge: Yahoo sold tech news site Engadget to Static Media in a deal that was signed in early February and is scheduled to close later in March — The consolidation of iconic internet publishing brands continues, as Static Media takes over another site. … Engadget, the long-running tech news website, has a new owner.
